tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The page ground. Ink by default; paper is the light theme. Never a gradient.

tokens.name: bg-panel
tokens.usage: A raised surface on bg: cards, code blocks, the terminal frame. One step up, never more.

tokens.name: bg-rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines, borders, dividers. The system uses rules, not shadows.

tokens.name: bg-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled fills and decorative strokes only. Never text.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on bg and bg-panel. 15.8:1 on ink.

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, taglines, key hints. 5.2:1 on ink, 5.3:1 on paper.

tokens.name: work
tokens.usage: work's signal. The dot, work's wordmark, and the one thing on screen that needs you. 6.8:1 on ink; the paper value is darkened to 4.6:1.

tokens.name: work-on
tokens.usage: Text and the knocked-out dot on a work fill.

tokens.name: work-tint
tokens.usage: A wash of work behind a needs-you callout or a selected row. 12% alpha, never for text.

tokens.name: flow
tokens.usage: flow's stream. The wave, flow's wordmark, and anything that is running or passed. 11.3:1 on ink; the paper value is deepened to 5.6:1.

tokens.name: flow-on
tokens.usage: Text and the knocked-out wave on a flow fill.

tokens.name: flow-tint
tokens.usage: A wash of flow behind an ok callout or a passing check. 12% alpha, never for text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: A refusal or a failed check, used as sparingly as work. 6.1:1 on ink.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring on every interactive element, 2px, offset 2px. Aliases flow so a keyboard user always sees the stream.

families.mono: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The wordmark size on a site masthead. One per page, lowercase, in the brand colour.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The tagline under a masthead, or a section opener. In fg.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title. Sentence case, no full stop.

styles.name: h2
styles.sample: The board is the state machine

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: One Claude Code session per GitHub issue.
styles.usage: The first paragraph under a heading. In fg.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A refused action never happens. The agent is told why, in your words.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Secondary text, footnotes, table cells. Often in fg-muted.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions under pictures and the smallest UI labels. In fg-muted.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks and terminal frames. Never smaller than this in a block.

styles.name: code-inline
styles.usage: Inline code in running text. Sized relative to the text around it, on bg-panel with a 4px radius.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase mono labels: tags, column headers, the state words. Tracked out.

styles.name: kbd
styles.usage: Key names in hints. Bold-ish, in fg, with the action after it in fg-muted.

spacing.note: A 4px base. Components use the even steps; the odd ones are for optical nudges.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps, icon-to-label inside a tag.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside a button vertically; between a glyph and its word in text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related lines, list item gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding, card inner padding on small screens.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding, paragraph spacing.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between components in a column.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections on a page.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding top and bottom on desktop.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Masthead padding; the breathing room around a display-xl wordmark.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a column of body text.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code, tags, small inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, code blocks, callouts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, and the logo tile (14 on a 64 grid).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills and the dot. Never on a button.

stroke.note: Line weights for rules and the drawn glyphs.

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: Every hairline, border and divider, in bg-rule.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring, in focus, offset 2px.

tokens.name: stroke-glyph
tokens.usage: The wave's stroke when drawn beside Geist Bold text: the bold stem weight.
